name: genpark-stripe-agentic-dynamic-payment-routing-fee-optimizer-skill

Evaluates transaction geography, card BIN networks, authorization probabilities, and basis-point rail costs (ACH, FedNow, Card Rails) to route payments along Pareto-optimal settlement paths.
